practice.title: about our practice
practice.content:
Real health is about both resolving symptoms and building up the body to be more resilient and strong.

We help you get to the root cause of your concerns with the latest advances in integrative medicine. We also help you be proactive about your health so that you can create positive and lasting changes in your happiness and life.

What makes us different is that we practice personalized medicine. Our treatments are tailored according to the patients’ individual physical, mental and emotional needs. We consider what makes a person unique through in-depth history intakes and thorough testing. We perform specialty tests of the immune system, nervous system, digestive system and nutrigenetic analysis, etc.

reviews.name: Elle
reviews.comment: I've been going to Dr. Afrooz since 2021 and before she switched buildings to this one. She gets to know her patients well and always knows what to look for and test for. reviews.name: Manzur Ahmed
reviews.comment: Dr Afrooz is my favorite. She is very knowledgeable and patient with her patients. I was always feeling very tired and lethargic and I was thinking that maybe I had long covid. But Dr Afrooz knew all the right questions to help identify that my condition is related to tick bites instead from a hiking trip I had gone on. I ask a lot of questions and she seems to not find me to be frustrating and i know that she is straightforward because she’s not afraid to say I don’t know if she does not know the answer to any of my questions. Nor is she dismissive of me whether it be ideas as to what I think could possibly help me or if I tell her something does not feel right. I highly recommend her and I feel fortunate to have been able to see her.

reviews.comment: This is one of the most convenient doctor offices that I have been to. reviews.comment:
I have known Dr. Afrooz for the past 8 years. Besides her knowledge and care she put in helping patients with different complex health issues, she is also one of the nicest people I know. naturopathic-medicine.title: naturopathic medicine
naturopathic-medicine.content:
What is Naturopathic Medicine?

Naturopathic Medicine is evidence-based medicine that treats the whole person by addressing the root cause(s) of illness and emphasizes prevention of illness. Naturopathic doctors educate and empower patients to be the leaders and decision-makers of their own health. Naturopathic medicine philosophy is grounded in the understanding that our bodies have an innate ability to heal; when disturbances to health are removed and the foundations of health are restored, our bodies can return to balance by first using the least invasive interventions.

Naturopathic doctors are trained in lifestyle medicine, botanical medicine, physical medicine, nutrition, homeopathy, mind-body medicine, pharmacology, nutraceuticals, and other modalities, and aim to individualize these treatments to support and restore function with no harm done to the patient.

Naturopathic Doctors (NDs) attend a 4-year post-graduate program that includes clinical training.

integrative-medicine.title: integrative medicine
integrative-medicine.content:
What is Integrative Medicine?

The field of integrative health and medicine reaffirms the importance of the relationship between practitioner and patient, focuses on the whole person, is informed by evidence, and makes use of all appropriate therapeutic approaches, healthcare professionals, and professions to achieve optimal health and healing. Simply put, integrative health and medicine offer best practices for optimal health and healing.

Integrative care seeks to develop a therapeutic relationship between the doctor and patient. This specialized form of medicine emphasizes the bio-psycho-socio-spiritual aspects of a person to improve health. The therapeutic relationship between the doctor and you results in longer in-depth appointments. During the appointment, the doctor discusses all aspects of your life and creates a customized treatment plan. Personalized care is offered based on the patient’s unique set of circumstances, including dietary choices, community, and family history, and lifestyle choices. This is because there are many things that influence health, including body, mind, spirit, and community. A variety of tests may be ordered, including blood tests, saliva tests, and more.

Additional information about the integrated medicine approach visit:

Academy of Integrative Health & Medicine: http://www.aihm.org/
American College for Advancement in Medicine: http://www.acam.org/

our-process.title: Our Process
our-process.subtitle: We help you understand your body, to achieve optimal health.
our-process.content:
We help you understand your body, to achieve optimal health.

STEP #1: CONSULTATION
(LISTEN, LEARN & APPLY)
Consultation
History Intake
Physical Exam

STEP #2: LABORATORY TESTING
(A CLOSER LOOK INSIDE THE BODY)
We run insurance-covered blood tests to investigate the root cause of disease. We also incorporate specialty tests including, Genova Diagnostics, Igenix Lyme testing, Real Time Labs mold testing, Great Plains Laboratory, Doctor’s Data, Cyrex, ALCAT Tests, ZRT Heavy Metal Tests, Galaxy Labs, Fry Labs, DiagnosTechs and neurotransmitter testing.
Lab Testing
Blood Tests
Specialty Tests

STEP #3: LIFESTYLE GUIDANCE
(HELPING YOU CREATE HEALTHY CHANGES)
Nutrition
Physical Activities
Environmental Toxins

STEP #4: EFFECTIVE THERAPIES
(DETOX, REJUVENATE & HEAL)
IV Therapy
Frequency Specific Microcurrent™ (FSM) Therapy
Craniosacral Therapy
Hyperberic Oxygen Chamber Therapy
Ion Foot Detox
Essential Oil
Consultations

STEP #5: SUPPLEMENTS, MEDICATIONS & DETOXIFICATION
(INDIVIDUALIZED FOR YOUR NEEDS)
Supplements, Nutrients and Medication

STEP #6: FOLLOW-UP
(WE JOURNEY WITH YOU)
We care about your long-term well-being. Follow-ups allow us to evaluate treatment effectiveness and to make any necessary adjustments to support your progress. We aim to build trust and lasting relationships with our patients.
Check-ins
Treatment Adjustments
Free Foot Detox
